info.sub_ename: LAW OF PUBLIC FINANCE AND TAXATION

description.sub_ename: LAW OF PUBLIC FINANCE AND TAXATION
description.describe_ch: 探討財政收支制度基本構造及法律問題，涵財政憲法及其基本原則、地方財政與地方稅、租稅法律關係、納稅人之權利保護等；兼司法院大法官解釋，並擇近年相關議題進行專題研討，強化學生之財稅法律專業能力。
description.describe_eh: This course will examine the framework of governing the allocation of government revenue and expenditure and its related legal issues. Topics to be covered include legal theory of fiscal constitution, general principles of public finance and taxation, fiscal burden, fiscal discipline of annual revenue and expenditures, public debt, local finances and local taxes, taxation and legal relationship, tax collections and legal protections of taxpayers, as well as related Constitution Interpretations of Grand Justices Council on public finance and taxation. Towards the end of the course, to strengthen students’ legal competency in this profession, there will be case studies based on notable topics in public finance and taxation in recent years.

targets.describe_ch: 學習對於財稅法律議題之法律分析與財稅法理之應用。
targets.describe_en: Learning legal analysis and the legal issues related Public Finance and Taxation, and know how to apply legal theories in a real case scenario.

targets.describe_ch: 強化法律人之財稅法律專業。
targets.describe_en: The course will focus on case-based discussion on Legal theories of Public Finance and Taxation.

targets.describe_ch: 有助提升未來從事公務員、律師、法官及公司法務等工作之專業能力。
targets.describe_en: To emphasize on lawyer's proficiency of Public Finance and Taxation, and to promote students' future working ability as civil service, attorneys, judges, as well as corporate legal consulates.
